title: 1573. Number of Ways to Split a String

examples.explanation: There are four ways to split s in 3 parts where each part contain the same number of letters '1'. "1|010|1" "1|01|01" "10|10|1" "10|1|01"
There are three ways to split s in 3 parts. "0|0|00" "0|00|0" "00|0|0"
